proposal.name: recording sessions

statements.name: Spec
statements.says: The session starts in its initial state and changes only by the modeled steps.

statements.name: OneRunning
statements.says: At most one recording is running, including while its capture is starting or waiting to restart.

statements.name: EveryAcceptedIsAccountedFor
statements.says: Every accepted recording stays in the saved record until it has ended and its end has actually been shown.

statements.name: StopIsLatched
statements.says: A Stop is saved even during startup before capture is asked to stop, and a Stop naming no running recording changes nothing.

statements.name: FinishAfterCapture
statements.says: Finishing is requested only after that recording’s capture has ended for good and can no longer write pieces.

statements.name: TypeOK
statements.says: The saved records, requests, reported results and specification histories have the declared bounded types.

statements.name: StartDecision
statements.says: A Start reaching this component is accepted whenever no recording is running, and otherwise is refused with a menu notice without changing the saved recordings.

statements.name: CaptureBelongsToRunning
statements.says: Every capture request belongs to the running recording and uses its original capture selection.

statements.name: ExactlyOneEnd
statements.says: An accepted recording has at most one end, whose reported result stays unchanged while its end awaits acknowledgement.

statements.name: KeptHasError
statements.says: Every kept recording has the error reported by finishing.

statements.name: NothingRecordedIsKept
statements.says: A report that nothing was recorded ends kept with an error saying that nothing was recorded and why.

statements.name: UnshownEndIsSaved
statements.says: Every end that has not been shown is still in the saved record.

statements.name: EndNoticeIsExact
statements.says: Each end notice gives the exact reported outcome and error and identifies the recording’s original pieces directory.

statements.name: StartingStopIsImmediate
statements.says: When capture reports that startup succeeded after a saved Stop, the session immediately asks that capture to stop.

statements.name: NoStartAfterStop
statements.says: No capture start or restart is requested for a recording after its Stop has been accepted.

statements.name: AutomaticStopExplained
statements.says: An automatic Stop of the named running recording emits a menu notice carrying its caller-provided reason.

statements.name: RestartBudgetIsSaved
statements.says: Each restart request consumes one saved retry before capture is asked to start, including requests interrupted by a crash, and never exceeds the bound.

statements.name: RestartShowsGap
statements.says: A successful restart uses the same recording and emits one gap notice, while an initial start emits no gap notice.

statements.name: OneFinishInOrder
statements.says: Only the earliest recording whose capture ended for good and whose finish is unanswered may be finishing, with at most one finish request in progress.

statements.name: GapKeepsRecording
statements.says: An unexpected capture end or a new launch keeps the same recording open for restart if it has no saved Stop and still has retry budget.

statements.name: CaptureFailureCloses
statements.says: When the caller reports that capture cannot start, the recording’s capture ends for good and its reported reason accompanies the queued finish.

statements.name: AcknowledgedEndsAreRemoved
statements.says: Once the caller acknowledges that an end was displayed, its recording is removed from the saved record.

statements.name: CrashKeepsSavedRecord
statements.says: A crash ends all capture and discards pending caller requests while preserving the whole saved record and finishing order.

statements.name: StoppedOrClosedEndsAndIsShown
statements.says: If On Air eventually keeps running and its caller answers each request, every stopped recording or recording whose capture ended for good eventually ends, has its end shown and leaves the saved record.

statements.name: GapsAreResolved
statements.says: If On Air eventually keeps running and its caller answers each request, every gap eventually leads to a counted restart request or capture ending for good.

statements.name: ResolveGapFair
statements.says: The session eventually resolves a pending gap whenever resolving it stays possible.

statements.name: SendStopFair
statements.says: The session eventually asks started capture to stop whenever a saved Stop keeps that request possible.

statements.name: FinishDispatchFair
statements.says: The session eventually requests the next finish whenever dispatching it stays possible.

statements.name: EndNoticeDispatchFair
statements.says: The session eventually requests an unacknowledged end notice whenever requesting that notice stays possible.

statements.name: HandedOver
statements.says: A recording can end handed over.

statements.name: HandedOverWithWarning
statements.says: A recording can end handed over with a finishing error to show.

statements.name: KeptWithError
statements.says: A recording can end kept with a finishing error.

statements.name: NothingRecorded
statements.says: A recording can end kept because nothing was recorded.

statements.name: EndAcknowledged
statements.says: All accepted recordings can have their ends shown and leave the saved record.

statements.name: StartDuringFinishing
statements.says: A new recording can be running while an earlier one is being finished.

statements.name: RefusalIsPossible
statements.says: A Start can be refused with its menu notice while another recording is running.

statements.name: StopDuringStarting
statements.says: A Stop can be saved while capture is still starting.

statements.name: GapIsPossible
statements.says: Capture can restart in the same recording and emit a gap notice.

statements.name: ExhaustedRestarts
statements.says: A recording can reach its restart limit and be queued for finishing.

statements.name: CrashWithUnshownEnd
statements.says: A crash can leave an unshown end saved for the next launch.

statements.name: CrashDuringRestart
statements.says: A crash can interrupt a restart whose attempt has already been counted.

statements.name: StartUnchecked
statements.says: A faulty Start accepts a second recording while one is running.

statements.name: ForgetWhenFinishRequested
statements.says: A faulty finish dispatch forgets the recording before finishing has replied.

statements.name: ForgetWhenNoticeRequested
statements.says: A faulty end notice forgets the recording before the caller confirms display.

statements.name: IgnoreStopDuringStarting
statements.says: A faulty Stop received during startup leaves the Stop unsaved.

statements.name: FinishWhileWriting
statements.says: A faulty finish dispatch joins pieces while capture can still write them.

proposal.module_text:
---- MODULE RecordingSession ----
EXTENDS Integers, Sequences, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Recordings, Errors, MaxRestarts

VARIABLES records, queue, online, capture, finishing, notice,
          attempts, stopAt, ends, shown, closedOrder, event

vars == <<records, queue, online, capture, finishing, notice,
          attempts, stopAt, ends, shown, closedOrder, event>>

\* records and queue are the whole saved record. An action that changes them
\* commits them before exposing any effect. All other operational state is
\* volatile. attempts, stopAt, ends, shown, closedOrder and event are ghost
\* observations for the specification, not additional data to save.
\* attempts and stopAt monitor start ordinals while capture can run. Once
\* capture closes, both use the canonical accepted ordinal 1 (or -1 for no
\* Stop): exact old retry counts are irrelevant because Closed can never run
\* again. This quotients history without changing any operational behavior.
\* An identity also represents its immutable original capture selection and
\* pieces-directory handle; neither choosing nor interpreting those is here.
\* Caller replies describe the current request. Duplicate or stale replies
\* have no effect. Writing pieces and idempotent archive delivery are outside
\* this component. A finish reply describes their durable, repeatable result.
\* event observes emitted effects, including nonpersistent refusal, gap and
\* automatic-stop messages. End notices alone require a display receipt.
\* Empty/nonempty is a finishing fact supplied by the caller, not a fact this
\* component infers from capture callbacks or by inspecting files.

None == "none"

Causes == Errors \cup {"stop", "retryLimit"}

NoError == [code |-> "none", why |-> None]

FailureError(e) == [code |-> "failure", why |-> e]

EmptyResult == [outcome |-> None, error |-> NoError, empty |-> FALSE]

NothingError(c) == [code |-> "nothingRecorded", why |-> c]

Results ==
    {[outcome |-> "handed", error |-> NoError, empty |-> FALSE]}
    \cup {[outcome |-> k, error |-> FailureError(e), empty |-> FALSE] :
             k \in {"handed", "kept"}, e \in Errors}
    \cup {[outcome |-> "kept", error |-> NothingError(c), empty |-> TRUE] :
             c \in Causes}

RecordType ==
    [phase : {"starting", "live", "retry", "queued", "ended"},
     stopped : BOOLEAN, retries : 0..MaxRestarts,
     cause : Causes \cup {None}, result : Results \cup {EmptyResult}]

IsBook(b) == DOMAIN b \subseteq Recordings /\ b \in [DOMAIN b -> RecordType]

Fresh == [phase |-> "starting", stopped |-> FALSE, retries |-> 0,
          cause |-> None, result |-> EmptyResult]

Queued(c) == [phase |-> "queued", stopped |-> FALSE, retries |-> 0,
              cause |-> c, result |-> EmptyResult]

Ended(v) == [phase |-> "ended", stopped |-> FALSE, retries |-> 0,
             cause |-> None, result |-> v]

NoCapture == [id |-> None, mode |-> None, attempt |-> 0, target |-> None]

NoNotice == [id |-> None, result |-> EmptyResult, directory |-> None]

NoEvent == [kind |-> None, id |-> None, before |-> [r \in {} |-> Fresh],
            beforeQueue |-> <<>>, running |-> {}, retry |-> 0,
            menu |-> None, reason |-> None]

Ids(s) == {s[i] : i \in 1..Len(s)}

Running == {r \in DOMAIN records :
              records[r].phase \in {"starting", "live", "retry"}}

Accepted == {r \in Recordings : attempts[r] > 0}

Stopped == {r \in Recordings : stopAt[r] >= 0}

Completed == {r \in Recordings : Len(ends[r]) > 0}

Closed == Ids(closedOrder)

TypeOK ==
    /\ IsFiniteSet(Recordings) /\ IsFiniteSet(Errors)
    /\ Recordings # {} /\ Errors # {}
    /\ None \notin Recordings /\ None \notin Errors
    /\ MaxRestarts \in Nat
    /\ IsBook(records)
    /\ queue \in Seq(Recordings) /\ Len(queue) <= Cardinality(Recordings)
    /\ online \in BOOLEAN
    /\ capture \in [id : Recordings \cup {None},
                    mode : {None, "start", "live", "stop"},
                    attempt : 0..MaxRestarts, target : Recordings \cup {None}]
    /\ finishing \subseteq Recordings
    /\ notice \in [id : Recordings \cup {None},
                   result : Results \cup {EmptyResult},
                   directory : Recordings \cup {None}]
    /\ attempts \in [Recordings -> 0..(MaxRestarts + 1)]
    /\ stopAt \in [Recordings -> (-1)..(MaxRestarts + 1)]
    /\ ends \in [Recordings -> Seq(Results)]
    /\ \A r \in Recordings : Len(ends[r]) <= 2
    /\ shown \subseteq Recordings
    /\ closedOrder \in Seq(Recordings)
    /\ Len(closedOrder) <= Cardinality(Recordings)
    /\ event \in [kind : {None, "accepted", "refused", "stop", "restart",
                         "started", "finish", "crash", "launch", "captureEnded", "failed"},
                  id : Recordings \cup {None}, before : {event.before},
                  beforeQueue : Seq(Recordings), running : SUBSET Recordings,
                  retry : 0..MaxRestarts,
                  menu : {None, "refused", "gap", "automaticStop"},
                  reason : Errors \cup {None}]
    /\ IsBook(event.before)

OneRunning == Cardinality(Running) <= 1

StartDecision ==
    /\ (event.kind = "accepted" =>
          /\ event.running = {}
          /\ event.id \in Running
          /\ capture.id = event.id /\ capture.mode = "start")
    /\ (event.kind = "refused" =>
          /\ event.running # {}
          /\ event.menu = "refused"
          /\ records = event.before /\ queue = event.beforeQueue)

CaptureBelongsToRunning ==
    /\ (capture.mode # None =>
          /\ online /\ capture.id \in Running
          /\ capture.target = capture.id
          /\ capture.attempt = records[capture.id].retries)
    /\ (capture.mode = None => capture = NoCapture)
    /\ \A r \in Running : online =>
          /\ (records[r].phase = "starting" => capture.id = r /\ capture.mode = "start")
          /\ (records[r].phase = "live" => capture.id = r /\ capture.mode \in {"live", "stop"})
          /\ (records[r].phase = "retry" => capture = NoCapture)

EveryAcceptedIsAccountedFor ==
    /\ DOMAIN records \subseteq Accepted
    /\ Accepted \subseteq DOMAIN records \cup shown
    /\ Completed \subseteq Closed
    /\ shown \subseteq Completed

ExactlyOneEnd ==
    /\ \A r \in Recordings : Len(ends[r]) <= 1
    /\ \A r \in DOMAIN records :
          (records[r].phase = "ended") <=> (r \in Completed)
    /\ \A r \in DOMAIN records \cap Completed :
          records[r].result = Head(ends[r])

KeptHasError ==
    \A r \in Completed :
        Head(ends[r]).outcome = "kept" => Head(ends[r]).error # NoError

NothingRecordedIsKept ==
    \A r \in Completed :
        Head(ends[r]).empty =>
          /\ Head(ends[r]).outcome = "kept"
          /\ Head(ends[r]).error \in {NothingError(c) : c \in Causes}

UnshownEndIsSaved ==
    Completed \ shown \subseteq DOMAIN records

EndNoticeIsExact ==
    notice.id # None =>
      /\ notice.id \in DOMAIN records \cap Completed
      /\ notice.result = Head(ends[notice.id])
      /\ notice.directory = notice.id
      /\ notice.id \notin shown

StopIsLatched ==
    /\ \A r \in Running : records[r].stopped <=> (r \in Stopped)
    /\ (event.kind = "stop" /\ event.id \in event.running =>
          event.id \in Stopped /\ records[event.id].stopped)
    /\ (event.kind = "stop" /\ event.id \notin event.running =>
          records = event.before /\ queue = event.beforeQueue)
    /\ (capture.mode = "stop" => capture.id \in Stopped)

StartingStopIsImmediate ==
    event.kind = "started" /\ event.id \in Stopped => capture.mode = "stop"

NoStartAfterStop ==
    \A r \in Stopped : attempts[r] = stopAt[r]

AutomaticStopExplained ==
    event.kind = "stop" /\ event.reason \in Errors /\ event.id \in event.running
      => event.menu = "automaticStop"

RestartBudgetIsSaved ==
    /\ \A r \in Running : attempts[r] = records[r].retries + 1
    /\ \A r \in Accepted : attempts[r] <= MaxRestarts + 1
    /\ (event.kind = "restart" =>
          /\ records[event.id].retries = event.retry + 1
          /\ capture.id = event.id /\ capture.mode = "start")

RestartShowsGap ==
    event.kind = "started" =>
      /\ (event.retry > 0 <=> event.menu = "gap")
      /\ capture.id = event.id /\ capture.target = event.id

FinishAfterCapture ==
    /\ finishing \subseteq Closed
    /\ Closed \cap Running = {}
    /\ (capture.mode # None => capture.id \notin Closed)
    /\ \A r \in finishing : records[r].phase = "queued"

OneFinishInOrder ==
    /\ Cardinality(finishing) <= 1
    /\ Len(closedOrder) = Cardinality(Closed)
    /\ queue = SelectSeq(closedOrder, LAMBDA r : r \notin Completed)
    /\ (finishing # {} => Len(queue) > 0 /\ finishing = {Head(queue)})

GapKeepsRecording ==
    /\ (event.kind = "captureEnded" /\ ~event.before[event.id].stopped
          /\ event.retry < MaxRestarts =>
            event.id \in Running /\ records[event.id].phase = "retry")
    /\ (event.kind = "launch" =>
          \A r \in event.running :
            ~event.before[r].stopped /\ event.before[r].retries < MaxRestarts
              => r \in Running /\ records[r].phase = "retry")

CaptureFailureCloses ==
    event.kind = "failed" =>
      /\ event.id \in Closed
      /\ records[event.id].phase = "queued"
      /\ records[event.id].cause = event.reason

AcknowledgedEndsAreRemoved == shown \cap DOMAIN records = {}

CrashKeepsSavedRecord ==
    /\ (event.kind = "crash" =>
          records = event.before /\ queue = event.beforeQueue)
    /\ (~online =>
          capture = NoCapture /\ finishing = {} /\ notice = NoNotice)

\* This is an environmental antecedent, not fairness imposed on the caller.
\* Each outstanding request receives its reply unless that launch dies.
CallerAnswers ==
    /\ \A r \in Recordings, n \in 0..MaxRestarts :
          []<>(~online \/ capture.id # r \/ capture.mode # "start" \/ capture.attempt # n)
    /\ \A r \in Recordings :
          []<>(~online \/ capture.id # r \/ capture.mode # "stop")
    /\ \A r \in Recordings : []<>(~online \/ r \notin finishing)
    /\ \A r \in Recordings : []<>(~online \/ notice.id # r)

StableService == (<>[]online) /\ CallerAnswers

StoppedOrClosedEndsAndIsShown ==
    StableService =>
      \A r \in Recordings : (r \in Stopped \cup Closed) ~> (r \in Completed \cap shown /\ r \notin DOMAIN records)

GapsAreResolved ==
    StableService =>
      \A r \in Recordings, n \in 0..MaxRestarts :
        (r \in Running /\ records[r].phase = "retry" /\ records[r].retries = n)
          ~> (attempts[r] > n + 1 \/ r \in Closed)

HandedOver == \E r \in Completed : Head(ends[r]).outcome = "handed"

HandedOverWithWarning ==
    \E r \in Completed : Head(ends[r]).outcome = "handed" /\ Head(ends[r]).error # NoError

KeptWithError ==
    \E r \in Completed : Head(ends[r]).outcome = "kept" /\ ~Head(ends[r]).empty

NothingRecorded == \E r \in Completed : Head(ends[r]).empty

EndAcknowledged == Accepted # {} /\ DOMAIN records = {} /\ Accepted = shown

StartDuringFinishing == Running # {} /\ finishing # {}

RefusalIsPossible == event.kind = "refused" /\ event.menu = "refused"

StopDuringStarting ==
    capture.mode = "start" /\ capture.id \in Stopped

GapIsPossible == event.kind = "started" /\ event.menu = "gap"

ExhaustedRestarts ==
    \E r \in DOMAIN records : records[r].phase = "queued" /\ records[r].cause = "retryLimit"

CrashWithUnshownEnd == ~online /\ Completed \ shown # {}

CrashDuringRestart ==
    ~online /\ \E r \in Running : records[r].phase = "starting" /\ records[r].retries > 0

\* Initial state is a fresh launch. The finite identity supply bounds accepted
\* Starts, not simultaneous unfinished recordings. No identity is reused.
Init ==
    /\ records = [r \in {} |-> Fresh] /\ queue = <<>> /\ online = TRUE
    /\ capture = NoCapture /\ finishing = {} /\ notice = NoNotice
    /\ attempts = [r \in Recordings |-> 0]
    /\ stopAt = [r \in Recordings |-> -1]
    /\ ends = [r \in Recordings |-> <<>>] /\ shown = {} /\ closedOrder = <<>>
    /\ event = NoEvent

Start(r) ==
    /\ online /\ r \notin Accepted /\ Running = {}
    /\ records' = [x \in DOMAIN records \cup {r} |-> IF x = r THEN Fresh ELSE records[x]]
    /\ capture' = [id |-> r, mode |-> "start", attempt |-> 0, target |-> r]
    /\ attempts' = [attempts EXCEPT ![r] = 1]
    /\ event' = [NoEvent EXCEPT !.kind = "accepted", !.id = r, !.running = Running]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<queue, online, finishing, notice, stopAt, ends, shown, closedOrder>>

RefuseStart(r) ==
    /\ online /\ r \notin Accepted /\ Running # {}
    /\ event' = [NoEvent EXCEPT !.kind = "refused", !.id = r,
                    !.before = records, !.beforeQueue = queue,
                    !.running = Running, !.menu = "refused"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<records, queue, online, capture, finishing, notice,
                   attempts, stopAt, ends, shown, closedOrder>>

\* None means the person's untargeted Stop (including Quit). An automatic
\* Stop names r and carries its caller-provided reason. A stale name is inert.
Stop(r, reason) ==
    LET target == IF r = None /\ Running # {} THEN CHOOSE x \in Running : TRUE ELSE r
    IN /\ online
       /\ records' = IF target \in Running
                       THEN [records EXCEPT ![target].stopped = TRUE]
                       ELSE records
       /\ stopAt' = IF target \in Running /\ target \notin Stopped
                      THEN [stopAt EXCEPT ![target] = attempts[target]] ELSE stopAt
       /\ event' = [NoEvent EXCEPT !.kind = "stop", !.id = target,
                       !.before = records, !.beforeQueue = queue, !.running = Running,
                       !.reason = reason,
                       !.menu = IF target \in Running /\ reason \in Errors
                                  THEN "automaticStop" ELSE None]
       /\ UNCHANGED <<queue, online, capture, finishing, notice,
                      attempts, ends, shown, closedOrder>>

CaptureStarted(r) ==
    /\ online /\ capture.id = r /\ capture.mode = "start"
    /\ records' = [records EXCEPT ![r].phase = "live"]
    /\ capture' = [capture EXCEPT !.mode = IF records[r].stopped THEN "stop" ELSE "live"]
    /\ event' = [NoEvent EXCEPT !.kind = "started", !.id = r,
                    !.retry = records[r].retries,
                    !.menu = IF records[r].retries > 0 THEN "gap" ELSE None]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<queue, online, finishing, notice, attempts, stopAt, ends, shown, closedOrder>>

CaptureFailed(r, e) ==
    /\ online /\ capture.id = r /\ capture.mode = "start"
    /\ records' = [records EXCEPT ![r] = Queued(e)]
    /\ queue' = Append(queue, r) /\ closedOrder' = Append(closedOrder, r)
    /\ capture' = NoCapture
    /\ attempts' = [attempts EXCEPT ![r] = 1]
    /\ stopAt' = [stopAt EXCEPT ![r] = IF r \in Stopped THEN 1 ELSE -1]
    /\ event' = [NoEvent EXCEPT !.kind = "failed", !.id = r, !.reason = e]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<online, finishing, notice, ends, shown>>

RequestStop(r) ==
    /\ online /\ r \in Running /\ records[r].stopped
    /\ capture.id = r /\ capture.mode = "live"
    /\ capture' = [capture EXCEPT !.mode = "stop"] /\ event' = NoEvent
    /\ UNCHANGED <<records, queue, online, finishing, notice,
                   attempts, stopAt, ends, shown, closedOrder>>

CaptureEnded(r) ==
    /\ online /\ capture.id = r /\ capture.mode \in {"live", "stop"}
    /\ records' = IF records[r].stopped
                    THEN [records EXCEPT ![r] = Queued("stop")]
                    ELSE [records EXCEPT ![r].phase = "retry"]
    /\ queue' = IF records[r].stopped THEN Append(queue, r) ELSE queue
    /\ closedOrder' = IF records[r].stopped THEN Append(closedOrder, r) ELSE closedOrder
    /\ capture' = NoCapture
    /\ attempts' = IF records[r].stopped THEN [attempts EXCEPT ![r] = 1] ELSE attempts
    /\ stopAt' = IF records[r].stopped THEN [stopAt EXCEPT ![r] = 1] ELSE stopAt
    /\ event' = [NoEvent EXCEPT !.kind = "captureEnded", !.id = r,
                    !.before = records, !.retry = records[r].retries]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<online, finishing, notice, ends, shown>>

ResumeOrClose(r) ==
    /\ online /\ r \in Running /\ records[r].phase = "retry"
    /\ IF records[r].stopped \/ records[r].retries = MaxRestarts
          THEN /\ records' = [records EXCEPT ![r] =
                    Queued(IF records[r].stopped THEN "stop" ELSE "retryLimit")]
               /\ queue' = Append(queue, r) /\ closedOrder' = Append(closedOrder, r)
               /\ attempts' = [attempts EXCEPT ![r] = 1]
               /\ stopAt' = [stopAt EXCEPT ![r] = IF r \in Stopped THEN 1 ELSE -1]
               /\ event' = NoEvent /\ UNCHANGED capture
          ELSE /\ records' = [records EXCEPT ![r].phase = "starting", ![r].retries = @ + 1]
               /\ attempts' = [attempts EXCEPT ![r] = @ + 1]
               /\ capture' = [id |-> r, mode |-> "start",
                               attempt |-> records[r].retries + 1, target |-> r]
               /\ event' = [NoEvent EXCEPT !.kind = "restart", !.id = r,
                               !.retry = records[r].retries]
               /\ UNCHANGED <<queue, closedOrder, stopAt>>
    /\ UNCHANGED <<online, finishing, notice, ends, shown>>

RequestFinish ==
    /\ online /\ finishing = {} /\ Len(queue) > 0
    /\ finishing' = {Head(queue)}
    /\ event' = [NoEvent EXCEPT !.kind = "finish", !.id = Head(queue)]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<records, queue, online, capture, notice,
                   attempts, stopAt, ends, shown, closedOrder>>

\* An empty recording's reply includes both 'nothing recorded' and why.
\* No filesystem operation is modeled; these are the caller's reported facts.
FinishReports(r) ==
    {v \in Results : ~v.empty \/ v.error = NothingError(records[r].cause)}

FinishReported(r, v) ==
    /\ online /\ r \in finishing /\ v \in FinishReports(r)
    /\ records' = [records EXCEPT ![r] = Ended(v)]
    /\ ends' = [ends EXCEPT ![r] = Append(@, v)]
    /\ queue' = Tail(queue) /\ finishing' = {} /\ event' = NoEvent
    /\ UNCHANGED <<online, capture, notice, attempts, stopAt, shown, closedOrder>>

RequestEndNotice(r) ==
    /\ online /\ r \in DOMAIN records /\ records[r].phase = "ended"
    /\ notice.id = None
    /\ notice' = [id |-> r, result |-> records[r].result, directory |-> r]
    /\ event' = NoEvent
    /\ UNCHANGED <<records, queue, online, capture, finishing,
                   attempts, stopAt, ends, shown, closedOrder>>

\* This input acknowledges actual display and commits its removal. If the
\* caller dies after displaying but before reporting it, no input occurred:
\* the saved end is requested again, and displaying it twice is harmless.
MenuSaid(r) ==
    /\ online /\ notice.id = r
    /\ records' = [x \in DOMAIN records \ {r} |-> records[x]]
    /\ notice' = NoNotice
    /\ shown' = shown \cup {r} /\ event' = NoEvent
    /\ UNCHANGED <<queue, online, capture, finishing,
                   attempts, stopAt, ends, closedOrder>>

Crash ==
    /\ online /\ online' = FALSE
    /\ capture' = NoCapture /\ finishing' = {} /\ notice' = NoNotice
    /\ event' = [NoEvent EXCEPT !.kind = "crash", !.before = records, !.beforeQueue = queue]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<records, queue, attempts, stopAt, ends, shown, closedOrder>>

Launch ==
    /\ ~online /\ online' = TRUE
    /\ records' = [r \in DOMAIN records |->
          IF r \in Running THEN [records[r] EXCEPT !.phase = "retry"] ELSE records[r]]
    /\ event' = [NoEvent EXCEPT !.kind = "launch", !.before = records, !.running = Running]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<queue, capture, finishing, notice, attempts, stopAt, ends, shown, closedOrder>>

Idle == UNCHANGED vars

Next ==
    \/ \E r \in Recordings : Start(r) \/ RefuseStart(r)
    \/ Stop(None, None)
    \/ \E r \in Recordings, e \in Errors : Stop(r, e)
    \/ \E r \in Recordings : CaptureStarted(r) \/ RequestStop(r) \/ CaptureEnded(r)
                              \/ ResumeOrClose(r) \/ RequestEndNotice(r) \/ MenuSaid(r)
    \/ \E r \in Recordings, e \in Errors : CaptureFailed(r, e)
    \/ \E r \in Recordings, v \in Results : FinishReported(r, v)
    \/ RequestFinish \/ Crash \/ Launch \/ Idle

ResolveGapFair == \A r \in Recordings : WF_vars(ResumeOrClose(r))

SendStopFair == \A r \in Recordings : WF_vars(RequestStop(r))

FinishDispatchFair == WF_vars(RequestFinish)

EndNoticeDispatchFair == \A r \in Recordings : WF_vars(RequestEndNotice(r))

\* This accepts a second Start and overwrites the capture slot without checking
\* whether another recording is still running. It is deliberately not in Next.
StartUnchecked ==
    \E r \in Recordings :
      /\ online /\ r \notin Accepted /\ Running # {}
      /\ records' = [x \in DOMAIN records \cup {r} |-> IF x = r THEN Fresh ELSE records[x]]
      /\ capture' = [id |-> r, mode |-> "start", attempt |-> 0, target |-> r]
      /\ attempts' = [attempts EXCEPT ![r] = 1]
      /\ event' = [NoEvent EXCEPT !.kind = "accepted", !.id = r, !.running = Running]
      /\ UNCHANGED <<queue, online, finishing, notice, stopAt, ends, shown, closedOrder>>

ForgetWhenFinishRequested ==
    /\ online /\ finishing = {} /\ Len(queue) > 0
    /\ records' = [r \in DOMAIN records \ {Head(queue)} |-> records[r]]
    /\ event' = NoEvent
    /\ UNCHANGED <<queue, online, capture, finishing, notice,
                   attempts, stopAt, ends, shown, closedOrder>>

ForgetWhenNoticeRequested ==
    \E r \in DOMAIN records :
      /\ online /\ records[r].phase = "ended" /\ r \notin shown
      /\ records' = [x \in DOMAIN records \ {r} |-> records[x]]
      /\ event' = NoEvent
      /\ UNCHANGED <<queue, online, capture, finishing, notice,
                     attempts, stopAt, ends, shown, closedOrder>>

IgnoreStopDuringStarting ==
    \E r \in Running :
      /\ online /\ capture.id = r /\ capture.mode = "start" /\ r \notin Stopped
      /\ event' = [NoEvent EXCEPT !.kind = "stop", !.id = r,
                      !.running = Running, !.before = records, !.beforeQueue = queue]
      /\ UNCHANGED <<records, queue, online, capture, finishing, notice,
                     attempts, stopAt, ends, shown, closedOrder>>

FinishWhileWriting ==
    /\ online /\ capture.mode = "live" /\ finishing = {}
    /\ finishing' = {capture.id} /\ event' = NoEvent
    /\ UNCHANGED <<records, queue, online, capture, notice,
                   attempts, stopAt, ends, shown, closedOrder>>

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars
====

pins.name: Spec
pins.says: The session starts in its initial state and changes only by the modeled steps.

pins.name: OneRunning
pins.says: At most one recording is running, including while its capture is starting or waiting to restart.

pins.name: EveryAcceptedIsAccountedFor
pins.says: Every accepted recording stays in the saved record until it has ended and its end has actually been shown.

pins.name: StopIsLatched
pins.says: A Stop is saved even during startup before capture is asked to stop, and a Stop naming no running recording changes nothing.

pins.name: FinishAfterCapture
pins.says: Finishing is requested only after that recording’s capture has ended for good and can no longer write pieces.

pins.name: TypeOK
pins.says: The saved records, requests, reported results and specification histories have the declared bounded types.

pins.name: StartDecision
pins.says: A Start reaching this component is accepted whenever no recording is running, and otherwise is refused with a menu notice without changing the saved recordings.

pins.name: CaptureBelongsToRunning
pins.says: Every capture request belongs to the running recording and uses its original capture selection.

pins.name: ExactlyOneEnd
pins.says: An accepted recording has at most one end, whose reported result stays unchanged while its end awaits acknowledgement.

pins.name: KeptHasError
pins.says: Every kept recording has the error reported by finishing.

pins.name: NothingRecordedIsKept
pins.says: A report that nothing was recorded ends kept with an error saying that nothing was recorded and why.

pins.name: UnshownEndIsSaved
pins.says: Every end that has not been shown is still in the saved record.

pins.name: EndNoticeIsExact
pins.says: Each end notice gives the exact reported outcome and error and identifies the recording’s original pieces directory.

pins.name: StartingStopIsImmediate
pins.says: When capture reports that startup succeeded after a saved Stop, the session immediately asks that capture to stop.

pins.name: NoStartAfterStop
pins.says: No capture start or restart is requested for a recording after its Stop has been accepted.

pins.name: AutomaticStopExplained
pins.says: An automatic Stop of the named running recording emits a menu notice carrying its caller-provided reason.

pins.name: RestartBudgetIsSaved
pins.says: Each restart request consumes one saved retry before capture is asked to start, including requests interrupted by a crash, and never exceeds the bound.

pins.name: RestartShowsGap
pins.says: A successful restart uses the same recording and emits one gap notice, while an initial start emits no gap notice.

pins.name: OneFinishInOrder
pins.says: Only the earliest recording whose capture ended for good and whose finish is unanswered may be finishing, with at most one finish request in progress.

pins.name: GapKeepsRecording
pins.says: An unexpected capture end or a new launch keeps the same recording open for restart if it has no saved Stop and still has retry budget.

pins.name: CaptureFailureCloses
pins.says: When the caller reports that capture cannot start, the recording’s capture ends for good and its reported reason accompanies the queued finish.

pins.name: AcknowledgedEndsAreRemoved
pins.says: Once the caller acknowledges that an end was displayed, its recording is removed from the saved record.

pins.name: CrashKeepsSavedRecord
pins.says: A crash ends all capture and discards pending caller requests while preserving the whole saved record and finishing order.

pins.name: StoppedOrClosedEndsAndIsShown
pins.says: If On Air eventually keeps running and its caller answers each request, every stopped recording or recording whose capture ended for good eventually ends, has its end shown and leaves the saved record.

pins.name: GapsAreResolved
pins.says: If On Air eventually keeps running and its caller answers each request, every gap eventually leads to a counted restart request or capture ending for good.

pins.name: ResolveGapFair
pins.says: The session eventually resolves a pending gap whenever resolving it stays possible.

pins.name: SendStopFair
pins.says: The session eventually asks started capture to stop whenever a saved Stop keeps that request possible.

pins.name: FinishDispatchFair
pins.says: The session eventually requests the next finish whenever dispatching it stays possible.

pins.name: EndNoticeDispatchFair
pins.says: The session eventually requests an unacknowledged end notice whenever requesting that notice stays possible.

pins.name: HandedOver
pins.says: A recording can end handed over.

pins.name: HandedOverWithWarning
pins.says: A recording can end handed over with a finishing error to show.

pins.name: KeptWithError
pins.says: A recording can end kept with a finishing error.

pins.name: NothingRecorded
pins.says: A recording can end kept because nothing was recorded.

pins.name: EndAcknowledged
pins.says: All accepted recordings can have their ends shown and leave the saved record.

pins.name: StartDuringFinishing
pins.says: A new recording can be running while an earlier one is being finished.

pins.name: RefusalIsPossible
pins.says: A Start can be refused with its menu notice while another recording is running.

pins.name: StopDuringStarting
pins.says: A Stop can be saved while capture is still starting.

pins.name: GapIsPossible
pins.says: Capture can restart in the same recording and emit a gap notice.

pins.name: ExhaustedRestarts
pins.says: A recording can reach its restart limit and be queued for finishing.

pins.name: CrashWithUnshownEnd
pins.says: A crash can leave an unshown end saved for the next launch.

pins.name: CrashDuringRestart
pins.says: A crash can interrupt a restart whose attempt has already been counted.

pins.name: StartUnchecked
pins.says: A faulty Start accepts a second recording while one is running.

pins.name: ForgetWhenFinishRequested
pins.says: A faulty finish dispatch forgets the recording before finishing has replied.

pins.name: ForgetWhenNoticeRequested
pins.says: A faulty end notice forgets the recording before the caller confirms display.

pins.name: IgnoreStopDuringStarting
pins.says: A faulty Stop received during startup leaves the Stop unsaved.

pins.name: FinishWhileWriting
pins.says: A faulty finish dispatch joins pieces while capture can still write them.
